abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Deployment Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: The target has the Enemy of the Everchosen keyword.

abilities.name: A Quest Well Done
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.effect: If the enemy Enemy of the Everchosen unit is destroyed by a unit in this Regiment of Renown, add 10 to the control score of each unit in this Regiment of Renown for the rest of the battle.

abilities.name: Predator Knights
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Enemy Turn
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. Then, this unit can use a Retreat ability as if it were your movement phase. No mortal damage is inflicted on this unit by that Retreat ability.

abilities.name: Victory Feast
abilities.timing: End of Any Turn
abilities.effect: If any models were slain by this unit this turn: • Heal (D6) this unit. • If this unit is in combat, this unit can immediately move 10". It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units but must end that move in combat with the units it was already in combat with at the start of the move. • If that unit is not in combat, this unit can immediately move 10" but cannot end that move in combat.

abilities.name: Projectile Vomit
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.declare: Pick this unit to use this ability if it has not used a Rampage ability this turn. Then, pick a point on the battlefield within 6" of this unit and pick each enemy unit within 3" of that point to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: 'What're you lookin' at?'
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.declare: Pick this unit to use this ability if it charged this turn and has not used a Rampage ability this turn. Then, pick an enemy unit within 9" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll 2D6. This unit can move a number of inches equal to the roll. It can pass through enemy models and must end that move in combat with the target.

abilities.name: Bellowing Mockery
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick this unit to use this ability if it has not used a Rampage ability this turn, then pick an enemy unit within this unit's combat range to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, subtract 1 from hit rolls for the target's attacks for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Stuff 'Em in Me Bag
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn, Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. If the roll is at least double the target's Health characteristic, 1 model in the target unit is slain.

abilities.name: Keep Up!
abilities.effect: While this unit is wholly within 12" of a friendly Mega-Gargant, this unit can use Charge abilities even if it used a Run ability in the same turn.

abilities.name: Spew Forth Sin
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick the Contorted Epitome in this Regiment of Renown to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Pick a friendly Hedonites of Slaanesh Manifestation that is not on the battlefield and that was not removed from play earlier in thte same turn. If you picked a Dreadful Visage or Wheels of Excruciation, set it up wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units. If you picked a Mesmerising Mirror, set it up wholly within 12" of the caster and visible to them.

abilities.name: The Mirror's Depths
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: If the target is within 6" of this unit, the target is gazing into eternity until the start of your next turn. Otherwise, roll a dice. On a 3+, the target is gazing into eternity until the start of your next turn. While the target is gazing into eternity, it must end all moves no further from this unit than it was at the start of the move and it cannot be removed from the battlefield by an ability that would allow it to be set up again on the battlefield. Designer's Note: *This includes pile-in moves.*

abilities.name: Swallow Energy
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: Pick a visible Manifestation within 12" of this unit and that was not summoned this turn to be the target, then make a banishment roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: If the banishment roll equals or exceeds the banishment value on the target's warscroll, it is banished and removed from play. The next time a visible friendly unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses a Summon ability, roll an additional D6, to a maximum of 3, when making the casting roll for that ability.

abilities.name: Deathless Monstrosity
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.effect: Heal (3) this unit.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged

abilities.name: Death on Tattered Wings

abilities.effect: Set up this unit in reserve high above the battlefield. It has now been deployed.

abilities.name: Loathsome Descent
abilities.timing: Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick this unit if it is high above the battlefield.
abilities.effect: Set up this unit anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Red Ruin
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, resolve the following effects: • Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. • Heal (X) this unit where X is an amount equal to the roll. This unit can be removed from the battlefield and set up in reserve high above the battlefield.

abilities.name: Justice Will Be Served
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick the Neave Blacktalon in this Regiment of Renown to be the target if it is in combat with an enemy Hero.
abilities.effect: The target can use 2 Fight abilities this phase. Each time it does so, if it is in combat with an enemy Hero, all of its attacks must target an enemy Hero. In addition, after the first Fight ability is used, the target has Strike-last for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Justice From Azyr
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit's Whirlwind Axes for attacks that target a Hero.

abilities.name: Windrider

abilities.declare: If this unit is in combat or charged this turn, this unit can make a pile-in move. Then, if this unit is in combat, you must pick 1 or more enemy units to be the target(s) of this unit's attacks.
abilities.effect: Resolve combat attacks against the target unit(s). Then, roll a dice. On a 3+, remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 3" from all enemy units and wholly within the combat range of a friendly The Blacktalons unit that is not in combat.

abilities.name: Aquatic Illusions
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target this unit.

abilities.name: Nebulous Sea-fog
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, while a friendly The Blacktalons unit is wholly within 6" of this unit, if the unmodified hit roll for a shooting attack that targets that unit is 1-5, the attack fails and the attack sequence ends.

abilities.name: Shield of Azyr
abilities.effect: While any friendly The Blacktalons Heroes are wholly within this unit's combat range, both this unit and those friendly units have Ward (5+).

abilities.name: Sparks of Profane Potential
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army),Deployment Phase
abilities.effect: Effect: If the Magister in the Regiment of Renown has been deployed, set up one of the following Manifestations within 1" of them: • 1 Burning Sigil of Tzeentch • 1 Tome of Eyes • 1 Daemonic Simulacrum

abilities.name: Skilled Summoner

abilities.effect: If there is already a friendly Manifestation from the list above on the battlefield, it is immediately banished. Then, set up the Manifestation you picked within 1" of the caster and visible to them. If that Manifestation is a Daemonic Simulacrum, it must also be set up more than 9" away from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Bolt of Tzeentch
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick the Magister in this Regiment of Renown to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.

abilities.name: Flickering Wyrdflame
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points inflicted on it this turn by Wyrdflame Spell abilities or attacks made with weapons that have the Wyrdflame weapon ability to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: Lunatic Demise
abilities.effect: Each time a model in this unit is slain, before removing the model from play, pick 1 of the following effects: *Split:* Pick a friendly Blue Horrors and Brimstone Horrors unit within 12" of this unit. On a 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

abilities.name: Imbued with Arcane Fire
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase

abilities.name: Spellmaster

abilities.effect: Make an unbinding roll of 2D6. If the roll exceeds the casting roll for the spell, the spell is unbound and its effect is not resolved. If the spell is unbound, add 1 to casting rolls for this unit for the rest of the phase.

abilities.name: Site of Slaughter

abilities.effect: Pick an objective wholly outside friendly territory. That objective is considered by you to be the amphitheatre.

abilities.name: Finishing Moves
abilities.effect: While each model in a unit in this Regiment of Renown is contesting the amphitheatre: • That unit's melee weapons have Crit (Mortal). • If you control the amphitheatre, if the unmodified hit roll or wound roll for an attack that targets that unit is a 1-4, the attack fails and the attack sequence ends.

abilities.name: Paragon of Slaughter
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible friendly Daughters of Khaine Infantry unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: If this unit is in combat, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the target's melee weapons for the rest of the turn. If this unit is not in combat, roll a dice. On a 3+, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the target's melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Dance of Death
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that charged this turn and is in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls and wound rolls for the target's combat attacks for the rest of the turn.

abilities.effect: Roll a dice for each target. On a 3+, that unit cannot use commands until the start of your next turn.

abilities.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for this unit's shooting attacks that target an enemy unit with 5 or more models that is more than 12" from this unit.

abilities.name: Watch Them Burn

abilities.effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the number of daemonic power points this unit has for each other enemy unit within the combat range of the target of this unit's shooting attacks. For each 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the enemy unit being rolled for.

abilities.name: Molten Mending
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Helsmiths of Hashut War Machine wholly within 6" of this unit to be the target. Add 6" to the range of this ability for each daemonic power point this unit has.
abilities.effect: Heal (D3+X) the target, where X is the number of daemonic power points this unit has.

abilities.name: Hatred for All

abilities.declare: You must use this ability if this unit is not in combat and there are any other visible friendly units within this unit's combat range. You must pick 1 of those friendly units to be the target.
abilities.effect: Resolve combat attacks for this unit against the target.

abilities.effect: Add 1 to the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for this unit, to a maximum of 3.

abilities.name: Hunters' Cohesion

abilities.effect: Remove this unit and the targets (if any) from the battlefield. Set this unit up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units. Then, set up each target wholly within 12" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Charging Volley

abilities.declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.

abilities.name: Star-marked
abilities.effect: Add 2" to this unit's Move characteristic while a Hunted enemy unit is on the battlefield. In addition, add 1 to hit rolls for this unit's attacks that target a Hunted enemy unit.

abilities.name: Astral Compass
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Deployment Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: The target has the Hunted keyword for the rest of the battle.

abilities.name: Dark Hunt
abilities.effect: In your charge phase, if this unit is not in combat and has not used a Run or Retreat ability in the same turn, it must use the 'Charge' ability, and if the charge roll would allow it to end the move within 1/2" of a visible enemy unit, it must do so.

abilities.name: Ravenous Shrieks
abilities.effect: Each time an enemy unit is destroyed by this unit's shooting attacks, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's Death Shriek for the rest of the battle (this effect is cumulative).

abilities.name: Shriek of Terror
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy Infantry unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice for each model in the target unit. For each 6, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target. If 3 or more damage points are allocated to the target by this ability, subtract 1 from hit rolls for the target's attacks for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Necromantic Limits
abilities.effect: This unit's Skeletal Talons have a maximum Attacks characteristic of 10. While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Skeletal Talons is 4.

abilities.name: Wicked Predator
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: For each champion, standard bearer, and musician in the target unit, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's Terrorgheist's Skeletal Talons, to a maximum of 10, for the rest of the phase. Those additional attacks must target that enemy unit.

abilities.name: Skeletal Splintering

abilities.declare: This spell can be cast by the same Wizard more than once per phase. Pick the Arkhan the Black in this Regiment of Renown to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them that has not been picked to be the target of this spell this turn to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the number of models in the target unit. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on that unit.

abilities.name: Unholy Sacraments
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the number of dice rolled when making banishment rolls for the Arkhan the Black in this Regiment of Renown, to a maximum of 3.

abilities.name: Discharge Armour

abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Ossiarch Bonereapers Wizard wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, add 1 to casting rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Ebon-wrought Armour
abilities.effect: This unit has Ward (3+) against damage points inflicted by Spell abilities, Prayer abilities and abilities used by Manifestations.

abilities.effect: Add 1 to the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for this unit, to a maximum of 3.

abilities.name: The Staff of Spirits
abilities.effect: Add 1 to casting rolls for this unit. Each time this unit successfully casts a spell, Heal (1) this unit after that Spell ability has been resolved.

abilities.name: The Doom of Traitors

abilities.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.

Designer's Note: *If the target is a* Wizard *or* Priest*, this ability cannot fail; however you still need to roll to determine the number of extra attacks it generates.*

abilities.name: Mortarch of Sacrament
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn, Reaction: Opponent declared a Spell ability for a unit within 18" of this unit
abilities.effect: Roll 2D6. If the roll exceeds the casting roll for the spell, then the spell is unbound, its effect is not resolved and that Spell ability cannot be used by enemy units until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: Curse of Years
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Roll 10 dice. For each 6: • Give the target 1 necrotic withering point. • Roll an extra dice. For each 5+ on those extra dice, repeat the above bullet points. Then, do the same for each 4+, and then each 3+. Finally, for each 2+, give the target 1 necrotic withering point (do not roll any extra dice), After a roll, if the target has 8 or more necrotic withering points, it is automatically destroyed. Otherwise, after the last roll, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the number of necrotic withering points it has. Then, those necrotic withering points are lost.

abilities.name: Ominous Fog
abilities.effect: Units in this Regiment of Renown are not visible to enemy units more than 12" from them while they are wholly within 9" of the Treelord in this Regiment of Renown.

abilities.name: Endless Wandering

abilities.declare: Pick a unit in this Regiment of Renown that is not in combat to use this ability.

abilities.name: Shadowcreep
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.effect: If this unit is wholly within the creeping overgrowth, remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 3" of a terrain feature and more than 9" from all enemy units. Then add 1 to charge rolls for this unit for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Strangling Grasp

abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 10" of this unit to be the target

abilities.name: Battle Damaged

abilities.name: Lash And Tangle
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Shooting Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by attacks made with this unit's Strangleroots to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll if the target is within the creeping overgrowth. On a 3+, subtract 1 from hit rolls for the target's attacks until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: Blighted Growth

abilities.effect: Set up this Regiment of Renown's Feculent Gnarlmaw wholly within friendly territory and more than 3" from all objectives and other terrain features. After you have done so, it has been deployed.

abilities.name: Multitudinous Diseases
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: If this Regiment of Renown's Plaguebearers unit is wholly within 12" of this unit's Feculent Gnarlmaw, pick that Plaguebearers unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Heal (1) the target. If the target is contesting an objective, you can also return 1 slain model to the target unit.

abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Plaguebearers unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

abilities.name: Stupefying Sneezes

abilities.name: Tendrils of Corruption

abilities.effect: For the rest of the phase, this terrain feature has a Move characteristic of 3" and can immediately move 3". It cannot move through or end that move within the combat ranges of enemy units and it cannot end that move on an objective or another terrain feature. Designer's Note: *This terrain feature cannot use* Move, Run*,* Retreat *or* Charge *abilities.*

abilities.name: Riddled With Disease
abilities.effect: Each time a friendly Maggotkin of Nurgle Daemon unit wholly within 12" of this terrain feature uses the 'Rally' command, you can make 1 additional rally roll of D6. If that unit is a non-Hero unit, you can make 3 additional rally rolls of D6 instead.

abilities.name: Cloud of Flies

abilities.name: Frenzied Violence

abilities.declare: Pick the Slaughterpriest in this Regiment of Renown to chant this prayer, pick a visible unit in this Regiment of Renown wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, the target unit has Ward (5+) while every model in that unit is wholly within the combat range of an enemy unit. If the chanting roll was 10+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target.

abilities.name: Glimpse the God

abilities.declare: Pick each unit in this Regiment of Renown that used a Fight ability this turn to be a target.
abilities.effect: If any damage points were allocated to an enemy unit by the target's combat attacks this turn, that enemy unit was destroyed this turn, and no damage points were allocated to that enemy unit this turn by combat attacks made by a friendly unit that is not in this Regiment of Renown, for the rest of the battle, add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of the target's Blood-hungry weapons.

abilities.name: Scorn of Sorcery

abilities.name: Off With Their Head!

abilities.name: Sneaky Prowlin'

abilities.declare: Pick all units in this Regiment of Renown if none of them have been deployed.
abilities.effect: Set up those units in reserve prowlin' around*. They have now been deployed.

abilities.name: Ambush Time!
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick all units in this Regiment of Renown if they are prowlin' around.
abilities.effect: Set up those units anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Vicious Snarls and Great Howls
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick this unit and up to 2 friendly Gitmob Cavalry units within this unit's combat range to be the targets.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the targets' Companion melee weapons.

abilities.name: Boss Snarlfang
abilities.effect: Add 2 to charge rolls for friendly Gitmob Cavalry units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

abilities.name: I Got Dis, Boss!
abilities.effect: While a friendly Snarlboss is within this unit's combat range, both this unit and that Snarlboss have Ward (5+).

abilities.name: Careening Destruction
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Movement Phase
abilities.effect: If this unit is in combat, it can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. It can pass through other models and the combat ranges of enemy units, but it cannot end that move in combat. Then, pick up to 1 enemy Infantry or Cavalry unit that this unit passed across during that move to be the target. Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. Add 1 to the amount of mortal damage inflicted for each model in this unit. Designer's Note: *This unit can use this ability even if it is in combat.*

abilities.name: Markin' Territory
abilities.effect: If this unit charged this turn, add 5 to its control score for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Frazzleburned Scrap
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.effect: If this unit charged this turn, it has Strike-first for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Insubstantial
abilities.effect: Ignore negative modifiers to save rolls for units in the Regiment of Renown.

abilities.name: Ghostly Paths
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: This spell can be cast by the same Wizard more than once per phase. Pick the Lady Olynder in this Regiment of Renown to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly unit in this Regiment of Renown that is wholly within 12" of them, that is not in combat and that has not been picked to be the target of this spell this turn to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Bulwark of the Necropolis
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with a unit in this Regiment of Renown to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target cannot use commands for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: No Rest for the Wicked
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick any number of friendly Nighthaunt units on the battlefield to be the targets.
abilities.effect: For each target, you can return a number of slain models to that unit with a combined Health characteristic of up to D3+3.

abilities.name: Mortarch of Grief
abilities.effect: If the unmodified hit roll or unmodified wound roll for an attack that targets this unit is 1-4, the attack fails and the attack sequence ends.

abilities.name: Grief-stricken
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Ignore positive modifiers to the target's control score and to hit rolls, wound rolls and save rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Harrowing Shrieks
abilities.effect: Enemy units cannot be healed or have slain models returned to them while they are in combat with this unit.

abilities.name: Spell-eaters
abilities.timing: Reaction: Opponent declared a Spell ability
abilities.effect: If a friendly Nighthaunt unit wholly within 12" of this unit was picked to be the target of that spell, this unit can use the 'Unbind' ability as if it had Wizard (1). Add 1 to the unbinding roll for that ability. If the spell is unbound, inflict D3 mortal damage on the caster

abilities.name: Engulfing Shadows
abilities.effect: Each time a unit in this Regiment of Renown is set up, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of that unit's melee weapons for the rest of the turn

abilities.name: Stalking Blades
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick the Mannfred von Carstein in this Regiment of Renown to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Inflict 1 mortal damage on the target for each other enemy unit within 3" of the target.

abilities.name: Cover of Night
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick 1 friendly unit in this Regiment of Renown that is not in combat to be the target.
abilities.effect: Remove that unit from the battlefield and set it up again more than 6" from all enemy units.

units.name: Mannfred von Carstein, Mortarch of Night

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of Ashigaroth's Claws is 3.

abilities.name: Ashigaroth's Hunger
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.effect: If this unit charged this turn, roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit has Strike-First for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: The Sword of Unholy Power
abilities.effect: If this unit has slain any enemy models this turn, for the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly Deathrattle and Deadwalkers units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

abilities.name: Wind of Death
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a point on the battlefield within 18" of the caster, pick up to 3 enemy units within 6" of that point and visible to the caster to be the targets, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: The Mortarch of Night
abilities.timing: Reaction: You declared the 'Redeploy' command for a Soulblight Gravelords unit wholly within 12" of this unit
abilities.effect: The unit using the 'Redeploy' command can move into combat when using that ability

abilities.name: Guardians of the King
abilities.effect: While any friendly Soulblight Gravelords Infantry Heroes are within this unit's combat range, both this unit and those friendly units have Ward (5+).

abilities.name: Fleet and Fell
abilities.effect: This unit can use Charge abilities even if it used a Retreat ability in the same turn. In addition, no mortal damage is inflicted on this unit by Retreat abilities.

abilities.name: Maddening Radiance
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons used by units in this Regiment of Renown while they are wholly within 12" of the Ushoran in this Regiment of Renown.

abilities.name: Deranged Transformation
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick the Ushoran in this Regiment of Renown to cast this spell, pick another visible unit in this Regiment of Renown wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn: • Add 2" to the target's Move characteristic. • Add 1 to wound rolls for the target's combat attacks

abilities.name: Summon Deluded Throngs
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick the Ushoran in this Regiment of Renown to use this ability, then pick another unit in this Regiment of Renown that has been destroyed to be the target
abilities.effect: Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) wholly within 6" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units. The replacement unit is part of this Regiment of Renown.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Monstrous Talons is 4.

abilities.name: Shroudcage Fragment
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick up to 3 enemy units in combat with this unit to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice for each target. If the roll exceeds the target's Control characteristic, the target has Strike-last for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Epicentre of Delusion
abilities.effect: Each time you make a delusion roll, you can add 1 or subtract 1 from the roll.

abilities.name: Glimpse of Delusion
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy model within 18" of this unit to be the target, pick another enemy unit that is visible to the target and within the target's combat range to be the victim, then make a casting roll of 2D6. You can only pick the target's unit to be the victim if that unit has 2 or more models.
abilities.effect: Pick 1 of the target's melee weapons. Immediately resolve combat attacks made with that weapon against the victim.

abilities.name: Predator Knights
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Enemy Turn
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. Then, this unit can use a Retreat ability as if it were your movement phase. No mortal damage is inflicted on this unit by that Retreat ability.

abilities.name: Royal Bodyguard
abilities.effect: While any friendly non-Monster Flesh-eater Courts Heroes are wholly within this unit's combat range, both this unit and those Heroes have Ward (5+).

abilities.name: Elite Guardians
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.effect: If this unit is in combat with any enemy units that charged this turn, roll a dice. On a 3+, for the rest of the turn, this unit has Strike-first but ward rolls cannot be made for it.

abilities.name: Searching for Remedies
abilities.timing: Deployment Phase
abilities.effect: Remove each unit in this Regiment of Renown from the battlefield and set them up again wholly within 6" of a terrain feature and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Soothing Pulse
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick the Branchwych in this Regiment of Renown to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Heal (3) the target

abilities.name: Slay The Trespassers!
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that is within the creeping overgrowth or that is visible to this unit and within friendly territory to be the target.
abilities.effect: Rolla dice. On a 3+, add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks that target that enemy unit for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Latching Paraspites
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: The target has the Infested keyword for the rest of the battle. Infested enemy units cannot move more than 6" when using non-Charge Move abilities.

abilities.name: Pain-Induced Frenzy
abilities.effect: This unit's melee weapons have Crit (2 Hits) if it charged in the same turn.

abilities.name: We'll Be There - If the Pay's Right
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Deployment Phase
abilities.declare: Pick each unit in this Regiment of Renown to be the targets if none of them have been deployed.
abilities.effect: Set up the targets in reserve preparing a flank attack. They have now been deployed.

abilities.name: The Horns Hit Home
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick each friendly unit that is preparing a flank attack to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Set up the targets on the battlefield, wholly within 6" of each other, wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Glutthorn's Horn and Hooves is 5.

abilities.name: Pitiless Warlord
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a Charge ability for an Ogor Mawtribes unit wholly within 12" of this unit
abilities.effect: Re-roll 1 dice in that charge roll.

abilities.name: Glutthorn Stampede
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll if the target is Infantry. On a 4+, the target has Strike-last for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Ravenous Counter-Attack
abilities.effect: Enemy units do not count as having charged while they are in combat with this unit.

abilities.name: Shock and Gore
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, for the rest of the turn, subtract 1 from wound rolls for the target's attacks.

abilities.name: Hour of Retribution
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn: • Add 1 to wound rolls for attacks made by units in this Regiment of Renown. • Add 1 to save rolls for units in this Regiment of Renown.

abilities.name: Arcane Heritage
abilities.timing: Reaction: Opponent declared a Spell ability
abilities.effect: If this unit or a friendly Stormdrake Guard unit wholly within 12" of this unit was picked to be the target of that spell, roll a dice. On a 4+, ignore the effect of that spell on this unit or that friendly unit. This unit can use this ability more than once per phase but only once per Spell ability

abilities.name: Wrath of the Draconith
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Stormdrake Guard unit within this unit's combat range to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of both this unit's and the target's Draconith's Fangs and Talons for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Dispersed Formation
abilities.effect: This unit has a coherency range of 2".

abilities.name: Draconic Onslaught
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.effect: If this unit charged this turn, roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit can move 2D6". It can pass through the combat ranges of enemy units and can end that move in combat. Then, pick an enemy unit that this unit passed across during that move. Inflict D3 mortal damage on that enemy unit.

abilities.name: Spell Hunters
abilities.effect: While both units in this Regiment of Renown are within each other's combat range, enemy Manifestations cannot be set up within 12" of either of those units.

abilities.name: Guardian and Mentor
abilities.effect: While this unit contains 2 models, it has Ward (5+).

abilities.name: Weapons of Banishment
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible friendly Sigmarite unit wholly within 12" of this unit and under orders to be the target.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, while the target is wholly within 12" of this unit and under orders, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of the target's weapons for combat attacks that target enemy Wizards, Priests, and Manifestations.

abilities.name: Expert Pathfinders
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Deployment Phase
abilities.declare: Pick this unit and up to two friendly non-Monster non-War Machine Sigmarite units if none of them have been deployed.
abilities.effect: Set up those units in reserve scouting ahead. They have now been deployed.

abilities.name: Prepared Arrival
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick this unit if it is scouting ahead.
abilities.effect: Set up this unit on the battlefield wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units. Then, set up each other friendly unit scouting ahead wholly within 12" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Vitiating Vapours
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from ward rolls for enemy units while they are within 12" of the Corpse Cart in this Regiment of Renown.

abilities.name: Legend among Graverobbers
abilities.timing: End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: Pick the Corpse Cart in this Regiment of Renown to use this ability if it is within 3" of the Deadwalker Zombies unit in this Regiment of Renown. Then, pick each enemy Infantry, Cavalry and Beast unit within 12" of the Corpse Cart to be the targets.
abilities.effect: For each target that had any models slain this turn, you can return D3 slain models to the Deadwalker Zombies unit in this Regiment of Renown.

abilities.name: Locus of Undeath
abilities.effect: Melee weapons used by other friendly Deadwalkers units have Crit (Auto-wound) while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

abilities.name: Mindless Ferocity
abilities.effect: Each time a model in this unit is slain by a combat attack and that model was in combat with the attacking unit, roll a dice. On a 6+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the Fight ability has been resolved.

abilities.name: Behold My Genius!
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.declare: Pick all friendly Volt-Klaw's Enginecoven units to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn: • Add 1 to hit rolls for the targets' shooting attacks. • Add 3" to the Range characteristic of the targets' ranged weapons.

abilities.name: Hide-shelter!
abilities.effect: While a friendly Volt-Klaw's Enginecoven Infantry unit is within the combat range of a friendly Volt-Klaw's Enginecoven Ratling Warpblaster, it is not visible to enemy units more than 13" away.

abilities.name: More-more Warpstone Bullets!
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.effect: If this unit is within the combat range of a friendly Skryre Hero, this unit's Hail of Warpstone Bullets has an Attacks characteristic of 6D6+3 instead of 3D6+3 for the rest of the turn. However, for each unmodified hit roll of 1 for an attack made with this unit's Hail of Warpstone Bullets, inflict 1 mortal damage on this unit after the Shoot ability has been resolved.

abilities.name: Overwhelming Fire
abilities.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for this unit's shooting attacks that target an enemy unit that has 10 or more models.

abilities.name: More-more Warpvolt Doom!
abilities.timing: Any Shooting Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by attacks made with this unit's Warpvolt Obliterator to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3 for each other enemy unit within the target's combat range. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll.

abilities.name: Lightning Master
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Warpvolt Scourgers unit within this unit's combat range to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, set the Attacks characteristic of the target's Warpvolt Scourgers to 10 for the rest of the turn.
